company.name: DeNet
company.shortDescription: DeNet provides decentralized data storage and web hosting services.
company.description: DeNet is a building ecosystem based on decentralized data storage. It targets users who want to have the convenience of Google Drive-like experience, high data security of services like ProtonMail and DuckDuckGo, and affordable product price. It is also a perfect solution for safely storing NFTs.
